response.justification: The candidate lacks critical required qualifications: no demonstrated experience with C programming for UNIX embedded systems, no Linux kernel modification experience, no familiarity with embedded networking security technologies like MACsec or 802.1X, and no Japanese language proficiency — all of which are non-negotiable for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Proven ability to build and maintain complex systems including embedded-like applications (e.g., DLang, real-time systems)
Active contributor to open-source tools and developer education, indicating strong technical communication
concerns: No C programming experience in embedded or UNIX environments as required
Zero evidence of Linux kernel analysis, modification, or embedded networking security expertise
No Japanese language proficiency — a mandatory requirement for the role
